safety_tips.title: Mind the gap
safety_tips.description: Step carefully while boarding. Stand behind the yellow line until the train fully stops.

safety_tips.title: Watch your belongings
safety_tips.description: Keep bags in front of you during peak hours. Report unattended luggage immediately.

safety_tips.title: No eating or drinking
safety_tips.description: Consuming food or beverages inside the train is prohibited and carries a fine.

safety_tips.title: Priority seating
safety_tips.description: Seats near doors are reserved for elderly, pregnant, and Divyangjan passengers.

safety_tips.title: Emergency helpline
safety_tips.description: Use the Talk-Back button in the coach or call NCRTC helpline 1800-209-0200.

safety_tips.title: No photography
safety_tips.description: Photography inside trains, platforms, or restricted areas is strictly prohibited.
